status: draft; numeric checks do not constitute game visual approval

density.plaza_rule: cell centre inside predefined layout_plan plaza [1450,900,2370,1430]

ground.method: BT.601 L, Pillow-equivalent GaussianBlur(radius4), signed original-blur population std

processing.stitch: unique 6 generated patches; min-cost irregular seam in 252px horizontal/112px vertical overlaps; 4px local feather, no repeated patches
processing.color: per-fragment RGB mean alignment; grayscale radius4 highpass gain, final common tint

repetition.method: all same-size aligned grid pairs, including bottom partial row; RGB MAE<=1 early proof of dissimilarity, no translation/rotation scan
